messages:
alicia: Heads up — seeing a sharp 5xx spike on /embeddings after the 11:02 deploy (dpl-4837). Multiple customers reporting search relevance suddenly broken.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PROD-EMBED-5XX — paging oncall.
deploy-bot: Deploy dpl-4837 (v3.2.1) finished. Canary started (10%).
sahil: I’m on logs. us-west-2 embed nodes show 502/5xx and weight checksum mismatch on ~3 replicas. Fetch logs now.
maria: quick check: v3.2.1 tokenizer mapping changed (extra tokens), embeddings will shift if vocab differs. could be a tokenizer mismatch rather than model math.
sahil: grabbing s3 manifests — weightset-v3.2.1 appears to have two namespaces. some hosts pulled alias "weights-latest" which pointed to v3.2.0 for a short window while manifest updated.
sam: if true, we have mixed-version canary => immediate mitigation: enable fallback to previous stable model and pause rollout.
alicia: setting kill-switch + fallback.
alicia: /flag set model.use_fallback=true --scope=prod
sam: flag API returned 200, propagating. Should route traffic back to v3.2.0.
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: model.use_fallback=true (applied to prod). Traffic routing: v3.2.0 now preferred.
incident-bot: On-call handoff: sahil -> maria for ML deep dive. PagerDuty acknowledged by alicia.
maria: spinning up a staging reproduce with the exact manifest/alias timing to validate tokenizer drift.
sahil: performing targeted rollback on the failing canary hosts in us-west-2.
sahil: command run:
```
redwood infra ssh --region us-west-2 --filter canary-hosts --cmd "sudo systemctl stop inference && rm -rf /var/models/weights-latest && systemctl start inference"
redwood deploy rollback --deploy-id dpl-4837 --target dpl-4836
```
sahil: rollback initiated, waiting for nodes to reinitialize.
alicia: watching metrics dashboard — 5xx rate dropping already on canary cluster.
alicia: confirmed: 5xx back to baseline in ~3 minutes after flag + rollback.
maria: root cause hypothesis: release pipeline updated the S3 alias (weights-latest) before the model manifest and tokenizer bundle were atomically sealed. A subset of hosts resolved alias mid-update and pulled inconsistent weights/tokenizer mapping.
sam: created incident ticket INC-2026-045 and scheduled postmortem. Suggested mitigations: require manifest+tokenizer atomic publish, checksum validation on load, reject alias updates during rollout window.
alicia: customer impact: ~12 customers affected, highest impact for AcmeCorp (degraded embeddings for ~5 minutes). Notifying CS for outreach.
pagerduty: Incident marked resolved by alicia at 1998765710. Postmortem owner: sam. Action items assigned to infra and release teams.
alicia: thanks team — great triage. Will follow up with PM/CS on customer comms and include remediation timeline in postmortem.
